quarterly_data.quarter: NetApp press release: NetApp Announces Intent to Acquire PEAK:AIO to Advance (09-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: NetApp announced its intent to acquire PEAK:AIO, a developer of metadata architecture and high-performance parallel file systems, to augment metadata services and parallel namespace innovation in its ONTAP-based architecture for AI clouds scaling shared storage alongside growing GPU clusters. The combined architecture disaggregates metadata from data, adds a global namespace and parallel NFS-based access, and is intended to support trillions of files and multi-exabyte deployments and to help reduce data-related GPU stalls. CEO George Kurian: 'AI clouds need high-performance shared storage that can scale alongside growing GPU clusters'. The transaction remains subject to customary closing conditions and regulatory approvals; NetApp makes no commitment on the timing of any resulting products.
